verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's proxy (gateway) docs have a dedicated caching page saying the system stores and reuses LLM responses to save costs and reduce latency, which matches the story directly. The evidence is only a one-line summary, repeated across two items, with no configuration depth. Missing for 10: documented cache backends and configuration (e.g., TTL, invalidation, per-request controls), and independent or hands-on corroboration that caching works at the gateway.

support.subject: As a developer, I can cache responses at the gateway to cut cost and latency on repeated requests

citations.quote: Cache LLM Responses. LiteLLM's caching system stores and reuses LLM responses to save costs and reduce latency.
